Scry finds any file on your PC by name in about a millisecond, forgives typos, and searches inside your text files. Press **Alt+Shift+Space** anywhere for the search bar.

### Install

Download **scry-…-setup-x64.exe** below and run it. No administrator rights needed: it installs for you only, starts Scry when you sign in and puts the `scry` command on your PATH (both can be unticked). The first run indexes your drives, about a minute; a notification says when it is ready.

**Windows may warn you** ("Windows protected your PC"): this build is not code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The **zip** holds the two programs without an installer: unzip anywhere and run `scry install --login` to start it at sign-in.

The tray icon shows the index status; right-click it to choose the folders Scry searches inside of and the ones it leaves out.
